intro_en: In this lesson you'll learn to talk about different kinds of silence, from the respectful hush around elders to the awkward pause at a family dinner. You'll also learn to describe how people seem using -х маягтай, -сан байдалтай, and -х янзтай.
intro_mn: Энэ хичээлээр ахмад настны дэргэдэх хүндэтгэлийн чимээгүй байдлаас эхлээд гэр бүлийн оройн хоол дээрх эвгүй завсарлага хүртэл янз бүрийн чимээгүй байдлын тухай ярьж сурна. Мөн хүн ямар харагдаж байгааг англиар seem, as if, as though, it seems that ашиглан тайлбарлаж сурна.

vocab.en: to fall silent, to go quiet
vocab.example_mn: Өвөөг ярьж эхлэхэд бүгд дуугүй болов.
vocab.example_en: When Grandpa began to speak, everyone fell silent.

vocab.example_mn: Ширээний ард эвгүй чимээгүй байдал үүслээ.
vocab.example_en: An awkward silence fell over the table.

vocab.example_mn: Энэ бол хүндэтгэлийн чимээгүй байдал юм.

vocab.en: to hold one's tongue, to keep quiet
vocab.example_mn: Тэр маргахыг хүссэн ч дуугаа хураав.
vocab.example_en: He wanted to argue but held his tongue.

vocab.en: to become pensive, to be lost in thought
vocab.example_en: Grandpa looked out the window, lost in thought.

vocab.en: to be offended, to feel hurt

sentences.mn: Өвөөг ярьж эхлэхэд ширээний ард бүгд дуугүй болов.
sentences.en: When Grandpa began to speak, everyone at the table fell silent.
alt_mn: Өвөө ярьж эхлэхэд ширээний ард бүгд дуугүй болов.
alt_en: When Grandpa started talking, everyone at the table went quiet.
sentences.mn_latin: Övöög yarij ekhlekhed shireenii ard bügd duugüi bolov.

sentences.mn: Авга эгч хариулахаасаа өмнө түр завсарлаад, ямар нэг юм нуух маягтай инээмсэглэв.
sentences.en: Auntie paused before answering and smiled as if she were hiding something.
alt_en: Auntie paused before answering and smiled as though she were hiding something.
sentences.mn_latin: Avga egch khariulakhaasaa ömnö tür zavsarlaad, yamar neg yum nuukh mayagtai ineemseglev.

sentences.mn: Ах асуултыг сонсоод гомдсон байдалтай цонх руу харав.
sentences.en: My brother heard the question and looked out the window, seeming offended.
alt_en: My brother heard the question and looked out the window as though he had been offended.
sentences.mn_latin: Akh asuultyg sonsood gomdson baidaltai tsonkh ruu kharav.

sentences.mn: Энэ эвгүй чимээгүй байдал удаан үргэлжлэх янзтай байна.
sentences.en: It looks like this awkward silence is going to last a long time.
alt_en: It seems that this awkward silence is going to last a long time.
sentences.mn_latin: Ene evgüi chimeegüi baidal udaan ürgeljlekh yanztai baina.

sentences.mn: Ахмад настан ярьж байхад үгийг нь таслах нь бүдүүлэг хэрэг.
sentences.en: Interrupting an elder while they are speaking is rude.
alt_mn: Ахмад настны үгийг таслах нь бүдүүлэг хэрэг.
alt_en: It's rude to interrupt an elder while they're speaking.
sentences.mn_latin: Akhmad nastan yarij baikhad ügiig ni taslakh ni büdüüleg khereg.

sentences.mn: Энэ бол эвгүй биш, хүндэтгэлийн чимээгүй байдал юм.
sentences.en: This isn't an awkward silence; it's a respectful one.
alt_en: This is not an awkward silence but a respectful one.
sentences.mn_latin: Ene bol evgüi bish, khündetgeliin chimeegüi baidal yum.

sentences.mn: Ээж яриаг өөр тийш нь эргүүлэх маягтай цай аягалж эхлэв.
sentences.en: Mom started pouring tea, as if to steer the conversation elsewhere.
alt_mn: Ээж сэдэв солих гэсэн маягтай цай аягалж эхлэв.
alt_en: Mom began pouring tea as though she wanted to change the subject.
sentences.mn_latin: Eej yariag öör tiish ni ergüülekh mayagtai tsai ayagalj ekhlev.

sentences.mn: Өвөө бодлогоширсон байдалтай удтал дуугүй суув.
sentences.en: Grandpa sat silent for a long time, looking lost in thought.
alt_en: Grandpa sat quietly for a long while, seemingly lost in thought.
sentences.mn_latin: Övöö bodlogoshirson baidaltai udtal duugüi suuv.

sentences.mn: Аав нэг юм хэлэх янзтай байсан ч эцэст нь дуугаа хураав.
sentences.en: Dad looked like he was going to say something, but in the end he held his tongue.
alt_en: It seemed that Dad was about to say something, but in the end he kept quiet.
sentences.mn_latin: Aav neg yum khelekh yanztai baisan ch etsest ni duugaa khuraav.

sentences.mn: Түүний чимээгүй байдал зөвшөөрч буй мэт санагдсан ч үнэндээ тэр эсэргүүцэж байсан бололтой.
sentences.en: His silence seemed like agreement, but it seems he actually disagreed.
alt_en: It seemed as though his silence meant agreement, but apparently he actually disagreed.
sentences.mn_latin: Tüünii chimeegüi baidal zövshöörch bui met sanagdsan ch ünendee ter esergüütsej baisan bololtoi.

sentences.mn: Хүргэн ах эвгүй чимээгүй байдлыг эвдэх гэж хошигнолоо.
sentences.en: My brother-in-law cracked a joke to break the awkward silence.
alt_en: My brother-in-law made a joke to break the awkward silence.
sentences.mn_latin: Khürgen akh evgüi chimeegüi baidlyg evdekh gej khoshignoloo.

sentences.mn: Зочид явах маягтай, гэрийн эзэн ядарсан байдалтай, гадаа бороо орох янзтай байлаа.
sentences.en: The guests seemed about to leave, the host looked tired, and it looked like it was going to rain outside.
alt_en: The guests looked as if they were about to leave, the host seemed worn out, and it seemed that it was going to rain.
sentences.mn_latin: Zochid yavakh mayagtai, geriin ezen yadarsan baidaltai, gadaa boroo orokh yanztai bailaa.

grammar.title_en: Seeming and appearing: -х маягтай, -сан байдалтай, -х янзтай
grammar.title_mn: Seem, as if / as though, it seems that
grammar.explain_en: Mongolian has several ways to say how someone or something seems, and each has its own shade. -х маягтай (future participle + маягтай) describes a manner or behavior that suggests an intention: 'явах маягтай' means 'acting as if about to leave.' -сан байдалтай (past participle + байдалтай) describes a visible state that results from something: 'ядарсан байдалтай' means 'looking tired, in a worn-out state.' -х янзтай (future participle + янзтай) is a conversational guess about what is likely to happen: 'бороо орох янзтай' means 'it looks like it's going to rain.' Think of it as manner (маяг), state (байдал), and likely outcome (янз). All three can appear in one description to paint a full picture.
grammar.explain_mn: Англи хэлэнд хүн юм ямар харагдаж байгааг хэд хэдэн аргаар хэлдэг. 'seem' нь ерөнхий төлөв, байдлыг илэрхийлнэ: 'He seems tired' (ядарсан байдалтай). 'as if / as though' дараа өгүүлбэр орж, тухайн хүний үйлдэл ямар мэт байгааг заана: 'She smiled as if she were hiding something' (нуух маягтай инээмсэглэв). Бодит бус, таамаг байдлыг онцлохдоо 'were' хэлбэр хэрэглэж болно. 'It seems that...' эсвэл ярианд 'It looks like...' нь нөхцөл байдлаас дүгнэлт хийхэд тохирно: 'It looks like it's going to rain' (бороо орох янзтай). Товчхондоо: seem нь байдал, as if нь маяг, it looks like нь янз гэж санаарай.

examples.en: He picked up his bag as if he were about to leave.
It looks like it's going to rain.

examples.mn: Өвөө нэг юм хэлэх янзтай байсан ч бодлогоширсон байдалтай дуугүй суув.
examples.en: It seemed that Grandpa was going to say something, but he sat silent, looking lost in thought.
examples.mn_latin: Övöö neg yum khelekh yanztai baisan ch bodlogoshirson baidaltai duugüi suuv.

fill_blank.explain_en: байдалтай describes a resulting state, so it follows the past participle -сан/-сон/-сэн/-сөн. Because гомдох has back vowels with о, the ending is -сон: гомдсон байдалтай.
fill_blank.explain_mn: Англиар 'looking offended' буюу 'seeming hurt' гэж байдал, төлөвийг илэрхийлнэ. Энэ нь монголын -сан байдалтай хэлбэртэй дүйнэ.

fill_blank.text: Ахмад настан ярьж байхад үгийг нь ___ нь ёсгүй.
fill_blank.translation: It's improper to interrupt an elder while they're speaking.
fill_blank.explain_en: үгийг нь таслах means 'to interrupt someone.' The other verbs (listen, respect, follow) are things you should do, so they wouldn't be called ёсгүй (improper).
fill_blank.explain_mn: Англиар 'to interrupt' гэдэг нь хэн нэгний яриаг таслах гэсэн утгатай. 'It's rude to interrupt' гэж ихэвчлэн хэлдэг.

fill_blank.translation: After hearing the question, Grandpa went quiet for a moment.
fill_blank.explain_en: дуугүй болох is the set phrase for 'to fall silent.' чимээтэй means 'noisy,' and ярианы and хүндэтгэлийн are noun modifiers ('of speech,' 'respectful'), so they don't combine with болох here.
fill_blank.explain_mn: Англиар 'to fall silent' эсвэл 'to go quiet' гэж хэлнэ. 'Grandpa went quiet' гэдэг нь ярианы хэлбэр.

fill_blank.text: She looked at me as ___ she didn't understand.
fill_blank.translation: Тэр ойлгоогүй юм шиг над руу харав.
fill_blank.explain_en: 'As if' is a fixed pair that introduces how something seems. 'As like,' 'as that,' and 'as so' are not correct English.
fill_blank.explain_mn: 'as if' нь салшгүй хослол бөгөөд 'юм шиг, мэт' гэсэн утгатай. 'as' үгийн дараа 'like', 'that', 'so' орохгүй.

fill_blank.text: It ___ that Grandpa wanted to be alone.
fill_blank.explain_en: 'It seems that...' is the standard pattern. 'Seem' is a state verb, so it is rarely used in the -ing form. 'It looks that' is not idiomatic; you would say 'It looks like' instead.
fill_blank.explain_mn: 'It seems that...' нь '...бололтой, ...юм шиг байна' гэсэн утгатай тогтсон хэлбэр. 'seem' үйл үгийг -ing хэлбэрээр бараг хэрэглэдэггүй. 'It looks that' гэж хэлдэггүй, харин 'It looks like' гэж хэлнэ.

fill_blank.text: There was an ___ silence after Dad's question.
fill_blank.translation: Аавын асуултын дараа эвгүй чимээгүй байдал үүслээ.
fill_blank.explain_en: 'Awkward silence' is a common collocation. 'An' requires a vowel sound, and 'awkwardly' is an adverb, so it can't describe a noun.
fill_blank.explain_mn: 'awkward silence' нь 'эвгүй чимээгүй байдал' гэсэн түгээмэл хослол. 'an' нь эгшгээр эхэлсэн үгийн өмнө ордог. 'awkwardly' нь дайвар үг тул нэр үгийг тодотгохгүй.

dialogue.speaker: Emily
dialogue.mn: Өвөө чинь асуултад хариулалгүй дуугүй болчихлоо. Би буруу юм асуусан юм болов уу?
dialogue.en: Your grandpa went quiet instead of answering. Did I ask something wrong?
dialogue.mn_latin: Övöö chini asuultad khariulalgüi duugüi bolchikhloo. Bi buruu yum asuusan yum bolov uu?

dialogue.speaker: Сараа
dialogue.mn: Санаа зоволтгүй. Тэр гомдсон биш, бодлогоширсон байдалтай байна шүү дээ.
dialogue.en: Don't worry. He's not offended. He just seems lost in thought.
dialogue.mn_latin: Sanaa zovoltgüi. Ter gomdson bish, bodlogoshirson baidaltai baina shüü dee.

dialogue.speaker: Emily
dialogue.mn: Гэхдээ бусад нь ч гэсэн нэг юм хүлээж байгаа маягтай чимээгүй суучихлаа. Надад эвгүй санагдлаа.
dialogue.en: But everyone else is sitting quietly too, as if they're waiting for something. It feels awkward to me.
dialogue.mn_latin: Gekhdee busad ni ch gesen neg yum khüleej baigaa mayagtai chimeegüi suuchikhlaa. Nadad evgüi sanagdlaa.

dialogue.speaker: Сараа
dialogue.mn: Энэ эвгүй чимээгүй байдал биш, хүндэтгэлийн чимээгүй байдал. Ахмад хүн бодож байхад үгийг нь таслахгүй.
dialogue.en: This isn't an awkward silence; it's a respectful one. You don't interrupt an elder while he's thinking.
dialogue.mn_latin: Ene evgüi chimeegüi baidal bish, khündetgeliin chimeegüi baidal. Akhmad khün bodoj baikhad ügiig ni taslakhgüi.

dialogue.speaker: Emily
dialogue.mn: Тэгвэл би юу хийх ёстой вэ?
dialogue.mn_latin: Tegvel bi yuu khiikh yostoi ve?

dialogue.speaker: Сараа
dialogue.mn: Зүгээр хүлээ. Хараач, өвөө одоо нэг юм ярих янзтай байна.
dialogue.en: Just wait. Look, it seems like Grandpa is about to say something.
dialogue.mn_latin: Zügeer khülee. Kharaach, övöö odoo neg yum yarikh yanztai baina.

dialogue.speaker: Дорж
dialogue.mn: Охин минь, чиний асуулт намайг залуу насаа дурсахад хүргэлээ.
dialogue.en: My dear, your question made me remember my youth.
dialogue.mn_latin: Okhin mini, chinii asuult namaig zaluu nasaa dursakhad khürgelee.

culture_note.en: In Mongolian families, a pause before an elder speaks is often a sign of respect, not discomfort. Younger relatives are expected to wait rather than fill the silence or interrupt. At Tsagaan Sar and other gatherings, guests who stay quiet and listen are often seen as well brought up. In many English-speaking settings, by contrast, a long silence at the table can feel awkward, and people often rush to fill it with small talk or a joke.
culture_note.mn: Монгол гэр бүлд ахмад хүн ярихаас өмнөх завсарлага нь ихэвчлэн эвгүй байдал биш, хүндэтгэлийн илрэл байдаг. Залуучууд чимээгүй байдлыг дүүргэх, үг таслах биш, тэвчээртэй хүлээх ёстой гэж үздэг. Цагаан сар болон бусад цугларалт дээр дуугаа хураан сонсож суудаг хүнийг төлөв хүмүүжилтэй гэж хардаг. Харин англи хэлтэй олон оронд ширээний ард удаан чимээгүй байх нь эвгүй санагддаг тул хүмүүс жижиг яриа эсвэл хошигнолоор түүнийг дүүргэх гэж яардаг.

review.notes: A well-built lesson with natural Mongolian and English and accurate grammar explanations. The only real issue was one fill-in-the-blank with a second possible answer.

opus_fix.notes: I found no real errors: the Mongolian forms, vowel harmony, register, translation pairs, blank answers and options, and en/mn explanations are accurate and consistent.
